# MrBot1000 runtime dependencies.
#
# SECURITY (v2.0.24c): pinned to exact versions to prevent a malicious/faulty
# upstream release from being auto-pulled (supply-chain risk). `requirements.txt`
# is the curated, reviewed set; `requirements.lock.txt` is the full transitive
# lock (hashable, reproducible) generated by `pip freeze`.
#
# To upgrade a pinned dep, bump it here deliberately AND run:
#   python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
#   python -m pip freeze > requirements.lock.txt
# then re-test before committing.

PySide6==6.11.1
ollama==0.6.2
python-dotenv==1.2.2
requests==2.33.0
httpx==0.28.1
feedparser==6.0.14
beautifulsoup4==4.15.0
ddgs==9.14.4
# v2.1.86 (ARCH-ENG-108): the following were imported at runtime but missing
# from this curated set — a fresh install would ImportError. Pinned to the
# installed versions.
openai==2.24.0          # brains' OpenAI-compatible client (llama-server/cloud)
psutil==7.2.2           # hardware detection (device_registry / hardware_plan)
# ARCH-ENG-160: also missing from this curated set, and NOT optional. Both
# `agents/integrations/wallet_crypto.py` and `agents/platforms/credential_vault.py`
# import Fernet at module level, so on a fresh clone `CredentialVault.__init__`
# raises RuntimeError("cryptography is required for wallet encryption") and every
# wallet/platform-secret path is dead. This is the same gap ARCH-ENG-108 closed
# for openai/psutil; it recurred because the curated set is reviewed by hand and
# nothing asserts that every third-party import in the tree appears here.
cryptography==50.0.0    # Fernet — wallet.key + platform_vault.json encryption
# Optional: headless-browser escalation for JS/bot-walled pages (web_eyes /
# WebController). The app degrades to text-only fetch without it, but install
# for full web-read capability. Also needs `playwright install chromium`.
playwright==1.55.0

# Optional capability sets are NOT in this file — install them explicitly so a
# default install stays small:
#   python -m pip install -r requirements-cloud.txt   (Anthropic)
#   python -m pip install -r requirements-live.txt    (CCXT exchange adapters)
#
# ARCH-ENG-160: both files existed only as README references; neither was ever
# written, so both documented install commands failed with a pip path error.
